# Test Fixture Sources

This directory contains images used for testing the face encoding pipeline.

## Image Sources

### `mona_lisa.jpg`

- **Subject:** Mona Lisa, painted by Leonardo da Vinci (~1503–1519)
- **License:** Public domain (original painting)
- **Source URL:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mona_Lisa,_by_Leonardo_da_Vinci,_from_C2RMF_retouched.jpg
- **Attribution:** Digitization by C2RMF (Centre de Recherche et de Restauration des Musées de France)
- **Notes:** Resized to max 800px for testing. Used as a positive test case (contains a clear face).

### `landscape.jpg`

- **Subject:** Mount Fuji from Shin-Fuji Interchange
- **License:** Public domain (likely; no specific copyright notice found)
- **Source URL:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mount_Fuji_(from_Shin-Fuji_Interchange).jpg
- **Attribution:** User-contributed image on Wikimedia Commons
- **Notes:** Resized to max 800px for testing. Used as a negative test case (no human face present).
